hero.bible_verse: “For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the Lord as the waters cover the sea.”
hero.library_body: Thousands of books, eBooks, journals, audio and video resources. Borrow, reserve, and read from anywhere.
hero.elearning_body: Enroll in courses taught by expert contributors. Complete lessons, take quizzes, and earn verified certificates.
hero.publishing_body: Submit manuscripts for review, share research papers, and reach a global audience of scholars and readers.
